_README: Roles for careers.html (the listing) and job.html?job={id} (the detail page). ADDING A ROLE is a data edit only — append an object to "roles": the listing counts, the open-before-closed ordering, the empty state and the whole detail page are all derived. The "id" is what job.html reads from ?job=. The "detail" block drives the Job details tab; omit any section you do not need and it is skipped.

roles.title: Junior Web Developer
roles.summary: Build and maintain client websites in HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with support from the senior team.

description: KZD Solutions is a Durban digital innovation company. We build websites, custom software and internal systems for South African businesses, and we look after them once they are live.

We are looking for a Junior Web Developer to help build and maintain client websites. You will work on live projects from your first week, with a senior developer reviewing your work and explaining the reasoning behind it.

why.title: You will do real work
why.body: Junior does not mean sidelined. You will be building and shipping client sites, not watching someone else do it.

why.title: Someone will teach you
why.body: Every piece of work you do gets reviewed by a senior developer who explains why, not just what to change.

why.title: You will see the whole picture
why.body: Design, build, deploy, support. A small team means you follow a project from brief to live site.

why.title: We are local
why.body: We are based in Durban, we hire in Durban, and the work stays here.

workOn: Building client websites in HTML, CSS and JavaScript
Turning designs from Penpot into working, responsive pages
WordPress theme and plugin work for client sites
Fixing bugs and making improvements on sites already live
Testing your work across browsers and on real phones
lookingFor: A qualification in IT, computer science or web development, or equivalent self-taught experience
Solid HTML and CSS. You can build a responsive layout without a framework
Working JavaScript. You understand the DOM and can debug your own code
Familiarity with Git and version control
Clear written and spoken communication in English
Based in Durban or willing to relocate. This role is on site
niceToHave: A portfolio, GitHub profile or personal projects we can look at
Basic understanding of hosting, domains and DNS

offer.title: Mentorship
offer.body: A senior developer reviewing your work and available for questions.

offer.title: Range of work
offer.body: Client websites, internal tools and our own products.

offer.title: Room to grow
offer.body: We would rather promote from inside than hire above you.

offer.title: A clear answer
offer.body: You hear back from us within 30 days, either way.

roles.title: Business Analyst Intern
roles.summary: Six-month placement working alongside our consulting team on real client process-improvement projects.

description: KZD Solutions is a Durban digital innovation company. We help businesses find waste, fix process and scale what already works.
This is a six-month placement on our consulting team. You will sit in on real client work, map how things currently run, and help propose what should change.

why.title: Real clients, not exercises
why.body: You will be in actual engagements, with your work forming part of what the client receives.

why.title: Someone senior on hand
why.body: A consultant reviews your analysis and talks you through how they reached their own conclusions.

why.title: You will see the whole picture
why.body: From first interview to final recommendation, on projects small enough to follow end to end.

workOn: Documenting how a client's process runs today
Sitting in on client interviews and writing them up
Building simple process maps and flow diagrams
Helping put together findings and recommendations
lookingFor: Studying towards, or recently finished, a business, IT or industrial engineering qualification
Organised, and able to keep notes someone else can read
Based in Durban. This placement is on site
niceToHave: Any exposure to process mapping or Lean
An interest in how businesses actually operate

offer.title: Mentorship
offer.body: A consultant who reviews your work and explains the reasoning.

offer.title: A real reference
offer.body: Six months of named project work you can point to afterwards.

offer.title: A clear answer
offer.body: You hear back from us within 30 days, either way.

roles.title: IT Support Technician
roles.summary: First-line support for our hosting and maintenance clients, on the phone and on site.

description: KZD Solutions is a Durban digital innovation company. As well as building systems, we look after them — hosting, maintenance and support for clients across South Africa.
We are looking for an IT Support Technician to be the first person a client speaks to when something is not working, and to see it through to a fix.

why.title: You own the problem
why.body: You are not passing tickets along. You see an issue from the first call to the resolution.

why.title: Someone senior on hand
why.body: Anything beyond first line gets escalated, and you sit with whoever picks it up.

why.title: We are local
why.body: Our clients are here, so you meet the people you help.

workOn: Answering support calls and email from hosting and maintenance clients
Diagnosing website, email and connectivity problems
On-site visits to client offices around Durban
Basic server, DNS and mailbox administration
Keeping a clear record of what was wrong and what fixed it
lookingFor: An IT qualification, A+/N+ or equivalent hands-on experience
Patient and clear with people who are not technical
Comfortable with Windows, basic networking and email configuration
A valid driver's licence for on-site work
Based in Durban. This role is on site
niceToHave: Some exposure to DNS and hosting

offer.title: Breadth
offer.body: Hosting, email, networks and websites, rather than one narrow queue.

offer.title: Room to grow
offer.body: Support is how several of our team started. We promote from inside.

offer.title: A clear answer
offer.body: You hear back from us within 30 days, either way.
